cohort: 51 patients who underwent EPH at the Department of Gynecology, Obstetrics and Urology of the University of Rome Sapienza from January 2000 to December 2013
finding: Abnormal placentation was the most common indication for EPH (requiring total hysterectomy in most cases), and previous CS was a significant risk factor for both EPH and abnormal placentation.
mod_finding: Forty-nine EPHs were performed after cesarean delivery (CS) and two after vaginal delivery (p < 0.0001).
